author: Jim Hirsch
content: It's probably inevitable that TiVo will face tough, if not crippling, competition from the cable operators. TiVo is [already in a profit crunch](http://www.businessweek.com/innovate/content/jan2006/id20060109_185287.htm?chan=tc), and now cable is bundling [DVR units](http://www.thisiscable.com/dvr-cable-box/services-features/index.html) along with a slew of other services. The cable operators already have those customers, and can sell them on an iPod/iTunes-style integration of product and service - something TiVo can't match.
